page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Notes in the right margin, beside the second paragraph. Catchword at the lower right. Printed folio 61 with running head at the top. A handwritten number 246 at the top right is not printed text and is left out.

main_text.p: stensa, cum nostra obedientia etiam cum ad summum gradum pervenit, lō-gissimè absit à perfectione Christi. Ipse Paulus, Philip. 3. v. 12, fatetur, se nondum metam apprehendisse, aut jam nondum perfectù esse: sed se experiendo persequi, an quoq; apprehendit, cujus etiàm rei causa apprehensus sit à Christo Jesu. Jac. 3. v. 2. In multis labimur omnes.

Etsi alioqui qualitates, Christi qualitatibus similes, in omnibus salvandis requirimus. Rom. 8. ver. 9. Quod si quis Spiritum Christi non habet, is non est ejus. Gal. 5. v. 24. Qui Christi sunt, carnem crucifixerunt, cum affectibus & concupiscentiis. Phil. 2. v. 5. Is sit affectus in vobis, qui fuit & in Christo Jesu. 1. Johan. 3. Quisquis habet hanc spem in eo sit tam, purificat se, sicut & ille purus est. Item, Quisquis in eo manet, non peccat: quisquis peccat, non vidit eum, neque novit eum. Mox plura.

II. Christum etiam viam Salutis ac2. Agnoscitur & probatur Christus Servator, confirmationem Doctrinae[?] suae per miracula. Doctrinam suam Miraculis multis cō-firmasse, nullus dubito. Siquidem ipse inquit, Johan. 5. ver. 36. Ego testimonium habeo, majus testimonio Joannis: Opera enim, quae dedit mihi Pater, ut ea perficerem, ipsa, in-quam, Opera, quae ego facio, testantur de me, quod Pater miserit me. Johan. 10. v. 37. Si non facio Opera Patris mei, noli mihi credere: Sin

page.notes: The handwritten number 246 at the top right is not printed and is omitted. The catchword "vera" is at the lower right, below the last line. The marginal note's "Doctrinae" is uncertain because of the cramped line break. The "2." in the margin has no matching reference mark visible in the text, so it is copied as a bare number inside the note. The scan is faint in places, and the italic and roman boundaries are read from the image.
